Application.Text1:
protocols:
protocol_id: P01
stage: 固定样本水凝胶浸渍
conditions: 固定卵巢；原文水凝胶含4%PFA、4%acrylamide、0.05%bis-acrylamide、0.25%VA-044、0.05%saponin和PBS；6–7ml/管，4°C
duration_original: 3–4 days
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:Methods/CLARITY processing of ovaries
boundary: 从固定样本开始；不记录麻醉/灌注/取材操作。

Application.Text2:
protocols:
protocol_id: P02
stage: 水凝胶聚合
conditions: 干冰除氧后37°C水浴
duration_original: 3 h
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:Methods/CLARITY processing of ovaries

Application.Text3:
protocols:
protocol_id: P03
stage: 被动透明
conditions: 200mM boric acid、4%SDS，pH8.5；10ml；每周换液2–3次；无电泳
duration_original: 4–8 weeks
time_role: clearing_duration
source_locator: S1:Methods/CLARITY processing of ovaries
boundary: 随样本大小/年龄变化；此段未明确清除温度；不能套用后文免疫染色37°C。

Application.Text4:
protocols:
protocol_id: P04
stage: 去除残留SDS
conditions: PBST为PBS+0.1%Triton-X；随后描述PBS缓慢摇动
duration_original: 1 day
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:Methods/Immunofluorescence staining
boundary: PBST/PBS文字差异保留。

Application.Text5:
protocols:
protocol_id: P05
stage: 一抗
conditions: 抗体详见Table S3；摇动37°C
duration_original: 2 days
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:Methods/Immunofluorescence staining

Application.Text6:
protocols:
protocol_id: P06
stage: 一抗后洗涤
conditions: buffer；摇动37°C
duration_original: 1 day
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:Methods/Immunofluorescence staining

Application.Text7:
protocols:
protocol_id: P07
stage: 二抗
conditions: 抗体详见Table S3；摇动37°C
duration_original: 2 days
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:Methods/Immunofluorescence staining

Application.Text8:

protocol_id: P08
stage: 成像前洗涤及折射率匹配

duration_original: PBST at least 1 day; FocusClear 1 h
